title: Velvety Molten Vietnamese Chicken Wrap
description: A sweet and light Vietnamese dish featuring ground ginger and wrapped in a pandan leaf, this recipe is Whole30-friendly and perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Grind the chicken breast in a food processor until it is finely chopped.
Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped chicken to the skillet and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ground ginger, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, prepare the pandan leaves by rinsing them with water and patting them dry with paper towels.
To assemble the wraps, place a portion of the chicken mixture onto the center of a pandan leaf and fold the leaf over the filling to form a packet.
Serve the wraps immediately, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
To cook the chicken mixture in a pressure cooker, brown the chicken in a little oil, then add the remaining ingredients and cook for 5 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
